## Complete counterexample in the printed question's scope

For the totally real field Q(sqrt(10)), the full ring of integers is Z[sqrt(10)]. The unit-difference and prime-element-difference graphs both have clique number 2. The minimum norm of a nonzero prime ideal is 2, so Long Question 7.2's proposed equality has left side 2 and right side 4.

The ideal (2, sqrt(10)) is nonprincipal and has norm 2. No unit or prime element belongs to it, so reduction modulo this ideal gives a proper two-coloring of both graphs. The edge {0, 1} attains both clique bounds. PROOF.md supplies every arithmetic and graph step. No class-number table, prime search, numerical approximation, unproved conjecture, or omitted computational certificate is needed.

A prime element here is a nonzero nonunit whose principal ideal is prime. It is not merely an irreducible element. The prime graph uses unit or prime-element differences; the additional unit-group-surjectivity condition for Lenstra–Hurwitz cliques is not imposed. The question has no PID hypothesis, and this packet does not answer a separately imposed PID-only or irreducible-difference question.

## Sources and exact scope

The target is Question 7.2 in [Problems In Groups, Geometry, and Three-Manifolds, arXiv:1512.04620v1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1512.04620v1). The relevant prime-element convention is specified in the first definition and Section 3 of the [Long–Thistlethwaite author manuscript](https://web.math.ucsb.edu/~long/pubpdf/LenstraHurwitz.pdf).

The manuscript's Theorem 3.1 is printed with a minimum principal-ideal norm. The problem list's displayed question instead uses a minimum prime-ideal norm. This distinction is retained explicitly: the proof evaluates the quantities in the printed question directly and neither identifies those two minima nor relies on repairing that theorem.

The separate mathematical audit inspected the pinned 16-page author manuscript. A separately hosted 17-page manuscript was checked in online text, but was not downloaded or fingerprinted and was not established to be the final journal version. The final journal full text and the full 2018 Lopez thesis were not inspected. Source identities and historical retrieval/inspection limits are recorded in SOURCE_MANIFEST.json. Publication preparation did not repeat those scholarly-source inspections.

## Review status

This is AI-assisted authored mathematical work with a separate AI-assisted mathematical audit. The accepted mathematical outcome is a complete negative counterexample in the source scope described above. Acceptance does not mean external human peer review, journal acceptance, or formal proof-assistant certification. Novelty and priority remain unverified. Bounded searches found no explicit earlier statement of this exact counterexample, but cannot establish exhaustive literature status or novelty.

Only authored proof/audit/acceptance prose and public verification metadata are included. Copied source documents, source text/images, datasets, raw code/certificates, and private coordination material are excluded. QUEUE.md and all existing repository files are unchanged.
